Existing snow and boarded-window overlays must continue to align. Repaint original roof surface only with same material and geometry, do not reshape, move, enlarge, raise, add dormers or extend it. Keep original same grade identifiable. NO CHIMNEY, no flue, no chimney pots, no smoke, no glass or blue reflections, no new windows/doors, no people, no props, no surrounding scenery, no text. Single isolated complete building with true transparent RGBA background. Match reference understated painterly small-game sprite texture, restrained warm earth palette and pixel-scale detail, no black-white Tudor revival contrast. Do not redesign a different house.
